html:
G'oya

Ikki qadam. Avval har ishtirokchidan bitta qiymat qoldiramiz, uning eng katta taklifini: GROUP BY bidder va MAX(amount). Endi savol oddiy: shu ro'yxatda ikkinchi o'rindagi summa. Saralab, birinchisini tashlab, keyingisini olamiz. Bo'lmasa NULL chiqishi uchun hammasini skalyar subquery ichiga olamiz.

Yechim

SELECT (
  SELECT best
  FROM (SELECT bidder, MAX(amount) AS best FROM bids GROUP BY bidder) b
  ORDER BY best DESC
  LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
) AS price

Namunada Aziz uch marta taklif bergan, uning hisobidagisi 36 mln. Malikaniki 34 mln, Bekzodniki 31 mln. G'olib Aziz, u 34 mln to'laydi. Ikki ishtirokchida 40 mln dan bo'lsa, ro'yxatda 40 mln ikki marta turadi va ikkinchi o'rin ham 40 mln.

Skalyar subquery hech qator topmasa NULL qaytaradi, shuning uchun bitta ishtirokchi yoki bo'sh jadvalda ham natijada bitta qator bor.

Tuzoqlar

Takliflarning o'zidan ikkinchisini olish Azizning o'z taklifini topadi: 36 mln dan keyin uning 35 mln i turibdi.

Noto'g'riSELECT (SELECT amount FROM bids ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) AS price

MAX(amount) WHERE amount < (SELECT MAX(amount) ...) ham shu xatoni qiladi va bunga qo'shimcha teng takliflarni tashlab yuboradi. DISTINCT yoki DENSE_RANK bu masalada ham xato: 40 mln va 40 mln teng bo'lsa, g'olib 40 mln to'laydi, 30 mln emas.

OFFSET ni skalyar subquery'siz yozsangiz, ishtirokchi bitta bo'lganda natija bo'sh bo'ladi, NULL qatori emas.

Boshqa yo'l

G'olibni chiqarib tashlab, qolganlarning eng kattasini olish ham mumkin:

WITH b AS (SELECT bidder, MAX(amount) AS best FROM bids GROUP BY bidder)
SELECT MAX(best) AS price
FROM b
WHERE bidder <> (SELECT bidder FROM b ORDER BY best DESC LIMIT 1)

Teng holatda ichki so'rov ikkala g'olibdan birini tanlaydi, qolgani o'sha summani beradi. MAX agregat bo'lgani uchun bo'sh to'plamda ham bitta NULL qatori qaytadi.
